name: any MCP app
lede: {{TAGLINE}} Connected to any AI app that supports MCP.
paste_label: Paste this into any AI agent that can run commands
steps_sub: Agents that can run commands set it up from the link. For apps that can't, use the settings below.
steps: The same local MCP server for every app.
In your app's MCP settings, under the name {{SERVER}}.

register.p: Then register it with the user's AI app as a local (stdio) MCP server named {{SERVER}}. If the app has a command for this (for example <app> mcp add {{SERVER}} -- <command> <arg>), use it. Otherwise merge it into the app's MCP config file, keeping every server already there; if a {{SERVER}} entry exists, ask the user before replacing it. Most apps use this shape:
{{ABS_NOTE}} {{WIN_ABS_NOTE}} Some apps name the top-level key servers or mcp; follow the app's own docs for the key and file location.

confirm.p: Restart the app or reload its MCP servers, and check {{SERVER}} is listed with its tools.
